panels.text: Kiran ને SMS આવ્યો: 'તમારો parcel ready છે. Delivery confirm કરો.'
SMS: 'Your India Post parcel is on hold. Click: http://indiapost-delivery.xyz/track123'
redFlags: Official India Post link: indiapost.gov.in — .xyz .com .net suspicious
Link URL ધ્યાન થી જુઓ — 'indiapost-delivery.xyz' fake
Parcel track ક્યારેય SMS link ન આવે — direct website check કરો

panels.question: Kiran શું કરે?
panels.correct: Link click ન કરો — indiapost.gov.in સીધી website open કરો

panels.wrongOutcome: ❌ Fake site — bank details enter કર્યા → account hack 😢
panels.rightOutcome: ✅ Kiran official website ગઈ → parcel safe track! 🎉

panels.rule: Link click કરતા પહેલાં URL ધ્યાન થી વાંચો.

panels.text: Kiran received an SMS: 'Your parcel is ready. Confirm delivery.'
SMS: 'Your India Post parcel is on hold. Click: http://indiapost-delivery.xyz/track123'
redFlags: Official India Post link is indiapost.gov.in — .xyz .com .net are suspicious
Read the URL carefully — 'indiapost-delivery.xyz' is fake
Parcels are never tracked via SMS links — visit the website directly

panels.wrongOutcome: ❌ Fake site — entered bank details → account hacked 😢
panels.rightOutcome: ✅ Kiran went to the official website → parcel tracked safely! 🎉

panels.rule: Read the URL carefully before clicking any link.

explanation.gu: sbi.co.in official bank link — .co.in India certified.
explanation.en: sbi.co.in is the official bank link — .co.in is India certified.

quiz.gu: SMS link click ન કરો — direct website જ visit કરો. આ advice ક્યારે?
quiz.en: Don't click SMS links — visit the website directly. When should you do this?

explanation.gu: હંમેશાં — SMS / WhatsApp link ક્યારેય click ન કરો.
explanation.en: Always — never click links in SMS or WhatsApp.
